name: dino
description: The Chrome no-internet T-Rex in a Claude Code pane, terminal and desktop. Space, click, or slap your MacBook (with ClaudeWhip) to jump.

pauseWhip.title: Pause ClaudeWhip while the game is open
pauseWhip.description: With ClaudeWhip installed, a slap then only makes the dino jump instead of also whipping Claude.

slapMinG.title: Smallest hit that jumps (g)
slapMinG.description: Typing makes ~0.03 g taps; hits below this are ignored.
